biggest_catch: There is no annual fee, so the math is clean: a $200 welcome bonus after $1,500 in 6 months is $200 net — the only real cost is meeting the spend with money you were spending anyway.
catches: Claim the bonus only with spending you already planned; never buy things you don't need just to hit the $1,500 target.
No annual fee on this card, so the fee does not eat the bonus — first-year net math is in the biggest catch above.
Applying for the card causes a hard credit inquiry, which can temporarily lower your credit score.
The variable purchase APR is roughly 20%+; carrying a balance wipes out the $200 fast — pay the statement balance in full every month.
The bonus is for new cardmembers only, subject to credit approval — additional limitations apply at application.
The official FAQ does not state a specific bonus-posting window, so there is no guaranteed payout date — keep the account open and track your statements until it lands.

payout_quote: Q: How do I earn the Citi Double Cash® Card's $200 welcome bonus? A: You can earn your $200 welcome bonus by spending $1,500 on purchases in the first 6 months of opening your Citi Double Cash® Card account.

steps: Go to the official Citi page https://www.citi.com/credit-cards/citi-double-cash-credit-card and read the FAQ's $200 welcome-bonus terms ($1,500 in the first 6 months).
Apply online through that official page and get approved; save your approval confirmation.
Within the first 6 months, put $1,500 of already-planned purchases on the card — never extra spending for the bonus.
Pay the statement balance in full every month — the variable APR is roughly 20%+; carrying a balance destroys the bonus math.
Keep the account open and check each statement — the official FAQ gives no guaranteed posting date, so confirm the $200 appears before relying on it.
Redeem the earned ThankYou Points for cash back (statement credit, direct deposit, or check) at thankyou.com.
timing: Citi does not state a specific posting window for the Double Cash welcome bonus in the official FAQ; track your statements until the $200 appears.
